title: Steering Vector Side Effect Measurement Suite: Quantifying Unintended Behavioral Changes

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Direct safety relevance: steering vectors are proposed safety interventions, and measuring their side effects is critical for deployment decisions. Clear chain from measurement to informed deployment choices.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Applying published steering vectors via TransformerLens is manageable, and evaluation on standard tasks is straightforward. However, sourcing five published steering vectors and setting up five different evaluation tasks adds coordination complexity for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Five steering vectors times five evaluation tasks is 25 evaluation runs plus baselines. Doable in 30 hours if vectors and eval datasets are pre-prepared, but the matrix is moderately large.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
